label: May qualify: confirm with the program
note: Portage never guarantees eligibility. Rules are quoted from each program's official page; the program decides.
agri_food_rule: Agri-food = HS chapters 01-24 (live animals, food, beverages including wine, fish and seafood).

tcs.what: Canadian trade commissioners in {country} give advice on the market and introductions to local contacts.
tcs.who: The Trade Commissioner Service says it works "with Canadian exporters and export-ready companies".

canexport.name: CanExport SMEs (2026–27)
canexport.what: Reimburses up to 50% of eligible costs of entering a new international market: $10,000 to $50,000 per project.
canexport.rule: Needs $300,000 to $100 million in annual revenue and 3 to 500 full-time employees; for-profit and incorporated (or an LLP or co-op) in Canada; prior sales in the target market under $100,000 or under 10% of total sales.
canexport.agri_rule: From 2026–27, agriculture, agri-food and fish and seafood projects go to AAFC's AgriMarketing program instead.
canexport.intake: The 2026–27 intake closed on August 31, 2026 (12:00 p.m. ET): the rules shown apply to the next intake.

agrimarketing.name: AgriMarketing: Market Diversification for SMEs (AAFC)
agrimarketing.what: Non-repayable funding for agri-food SMEs entering new markets (market research, missions, in-market promotion, translation): AAFC pays up to 70% of costs, usually under $100,000 per project.
agrimarketing.rule: For-profit or Indigenous organizations with fewer than 500 full-time-equivalent employees; no minimum revenue is stated. Not for markets you've been active in for 5+ years.
agrimarketing.intake: Open from February 13, 2026 until September 30, 2030. Sectors hit by tariffs in the past 12 months get priority.

edc.name: Export Development Canada (EDC)
edc.what: Export credit insurance (EDC Select covers single buyers or invoices, typically $5,000–$500,000, for occasional exporters), working-capital guarantees through your bank (Export Guarantee Program), and a free Export Help Hub.
edc.rule: EDC says it "helps Canadian businesses of all sizes and sectors".
